'''2002 World Championship Top 8 Jonny Chu LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jonny Chu]] at [[2002 World Championship]] (Top 8), finishing 6th; the list below is from the official Players Committee decklist form.<ref name="src">[http://www.theforce.net/ccg/sw/decks/chuLS.pdf SWCCG Players Committee decklist form: LS Combat Racing]</ref>

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jonny Chu]]
* '''Event:''' [[2002 World Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Top 8
* '''Finish:''' 6th
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' LS Combat Racing
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Source:''' [http://www.theforce.net/ccg/sw/decks/chuLS.pdf PC decklist form]
